overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25, accession 0002074176-26-000010), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. 50): the investing-activities section for 2025/2024/2023 lists ONLY 'Acquisitions of oil and natural gas interests' $(1,549)M / $(696)M / $(830)M, 'Acquisitions of oil and natural gas interests—related party' $(875)M / $— / $(75)M and 'Proceeds from sale of oil and natural gas interests' $— / $88M / $(3)M, netting to $(2,424)M / $(608)M / $(908)M. There is no purchases-of-property-plant-and-equipment, fixed-asset or capital-expenditure line anywhere in the statement for any of the three years (the balance sheet carries only $8M of other property, equipment and land at FY2025).
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every candidate tag the engine reads, because Viper is a mineral/royalty owner that buys no property or equipment: operators bear all drilling and completion capex on its acreage. Its investing outflows are acquisitions of mineral interests — growth investment, not maintenance capex (the same distinction the sweep applied to Royal Gold's stream/royalty acquisitions). The filing's cash-flow statement fully accounts for investing activities for all three years with no PPE purchase line, so PPE capex is $0 as a filing fact, not an estimate. Measured impact is nil: the engine's history already carried capex as assumed-zero, so the override changes no OE figure — it converts a silent zero-fill into a sourced, registered decision.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25, accession 0002074176-26-000010), Consolidated Statements of Changes in Stockholders' Equity (pp. 51-52), row 'Equity-based compensation' credited to additional paid-in capital: $7M for FY2025, with $3M for FY2024 and $1M for FY2023 in the same statement. The cash-flow statement (p. 50) carries no separate equity-compensation addback line — it is inside the 'Other' operating adjustment of $13M / $6M / $3M — which is why EDGAR companyfacts has no ShareBasedCompensation fact for this filer.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every tag the engine reads (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense have no facts in this filer's companyfacts). The filer's own equity statement reports equity-based compensation of $7M (FY2025) / $3M (FY2024) / $1M (FY2023). The engine applies this single FY2025 value to every missing period, which overstates FY2023 SBC by $6M and FY2024 by $4M against the same statement's true values — both in the conservative direction of lowering owner's earnings, and immaterial either way (FY2025 SBC is 0.7% of FY2025 OCF of $1,053M). ttm.py prorates the same value across its legs, leaving TTM SBC at the FY2025 figure.
